title: Long-range prey smell for the half-taxis digestion predators: do they cross gaps and hop between prey?
summary: Add a prey-made signal S (made by prey catalysis, range ~30 px) and a weak predator drift up S to 20261027T2013-c60-halftaxis-ecology; screen two strengths at 128^2 and measure free spells, hops (c56 freepred.py) and predator division.
